Strategy: Reward residuals between thirty and forty-five while penalizing residuals between eight and twenty-two more strongly, building on a combination that already beat Best Fit on another seed. This pushes harder away from awkward small gaps, but the stronger penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits that would otherwise work.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
